status: Mixed exercise draft; teaching allocations require review
scope: 50 mixed sentence exercises per lesson. Level 1 Lesson 1 is recognition-only; Levels 2–6 Lesson 1 have 30 pattern choices and 10 earlier-level revision translations each way. Other lessons mix 10 recognition, 20 English-to-Māori and 20 Māori-to-English attempts.

constraints.progression: Small additions of new language inside familiar frames; known vocabulary for grammatical contrasts; cumulative recall.
